findings.text: T-172 capped the 1F NE-2 / SE-1 corner at +11.00 (1.30 above +9.70); the SE frame draws the corner line 1BFD to +11.30 and T-159 reads the SE face's NE end as printed +11.30 ('6800' above +4.30 + '200'): 1.60 lm above +9.70; the row bound 0 .. 11.90 still holds (closure inside it).

1F NE-2 parapet top is not one level: the NW frame draws its NW end at +10.80 with an r 0.20 end round (27B6, 2584 .. 2579) and the SE frame its SE end at +11.30 (1BFD, 2220); the T-159 / T-747 NE-2 parapet outer face 19.27 x 1.30 = 25.051 m2 (sheet 09 '130') is therefore not a single-level face: the '130' witness line should be re-read by the Checker on sheet 09 (raster; nothing is scaled here). No m2 moved by this task; the step arris on the NE face (0.50 m where +11.30 drops to +10.80) is HELD blank by name (position not on a vector view).

the SE entrance stone surround is drawn on the front layer 1 in the porch-mouth plane, D-GF-07 and its landing on the beyond layer 5: the surround is not on GF/SE-2. T-747's 0 .. 1.298383 m2 paint deduction on SE-2 (storey 1.075883 + plinth 0.222500) is removed; the surround is the T-360 C-1 porch-mouth arch piece (1.514884 m2 visible, crown block 0.134936 cut by 2416), an open side with no face key: its render / paint is a missing item HELD blank.
W15 / W16 / W26 developed outlines re-measured from the DXF head chains agree with the merged T-405 ledger within 0.0004 m each; T-746's rectangles (to the crown) are refused: -2.338 lm.

the NW-5 bay pier rises from +5.50 to +11.00 (NW frame) in front of a wave wall whose top is +9.80: its back above +9.80 (roof side) is drawn in no view read (the 2F plan draws only its front), so any arris there is HELD blank, not counted. The T-159 key corner SW-1 / NW-5 coincides with the pier's SW return (2783, the 0.08 recess return and the 0.305 pier return in one line): the arris there is the pier's rounded corner r 0.10 (2728 .. 2783), same height (+11.00); one arris, count unchanged.

surround.verdict: OFF_FACE: the stones are drawn on the front layer 1 in the porch-mouth plane; the face that holds D-GF-07 (door line 1C00, landing 1BFE) is drawn beyond on layer 5. The surround is the porch-mouth arch piece (T-360 C-1, an open side with no face key), not a zone of GF/SE-2: the SE-2 paint deduction is 0 and the surround's own render / paint is a missing item HELD blank (material unprinted, the half behind the annex section line 2416 UNKNOWN)
